# KB Taxonomy and Linking

## When to Use
- Choose the right folder for a new note.
- Decide whether to update an existing note versus creating a new one.
- Pick tags, note names, and related-concept wikilinks.
- Propose the smallest safe taxonomy extension when the current structure does not fit.

## Procedure
1. Inspect nearby notes in the candidate area first.
2. Use the [domain map](./references/domain-map.md) to find the closest existing home.
3. Prefer the area the reader would search first for the topic.
4. Reuse existing tag style and note naming patterns from neighboring notes.
5. Add wikilinks to the closest adjacent concepts instead of scattering duplicate content.
6. If the topic still does not fit, propose the smallest viable subfolder under an existing area before creating a new top-level area.

## Output Expectations
- Recommended file path
- Reasoning for the placement
- Suggested tags
- Suggested wikilinks
- Whether an existing note should be updated instead of creating a new one
